data.name: CheckBoxLuminousReflectance.ToolTip
data.value: Calculate Luminous Reflectance and/or Transmittance, which is the weighted average of the spectrum. Calculation uses the product of the measured spectrum, a D65 irradiance, and the human eye efficiency as defined in ISO 13666:2012.

data.name: CheckBoxYID1925.ToolTip
data.value: Calculate Yellowness Index (YI) per ASTM D1925. Calculation uses the product of the measured spectrum and Illuminance C with a 2 degree observer, together with the equation 100*(1.2750X - 1.0576Z)/Y. Note that since ASTM D1925 is only defined for Illuminant C and a 2 degree observer, the setting for Illuminant and Observer in the Setup->Display dialog are ignored when computing YI D1925.

data.name: TextBoxNumGrading.ToolTip
data.value:
Amount of compositional grading in layer, expressed as a density percentage between -100% to 100%.
Setting a grading of 100% means that the material density at one interface is the same as vacuum and the material density at the other interface is 200% of its nominal value.
Positive values for grading mean that the material density nearest the Substrate is greater than the material density farthest from the Substrate.

data.name: NumericUpDownRequiredPeaks.ToolTip
data.value: If number of peaks detected in spectrum is less than expected, number of peaks that must be detected when automatically positioning peaks. For example, if a polished Si wafer has 3 peaks, this parameter may be set to 2 in order to concentrate on positioning the first two peaks.

data.name: CheckBoxHardLimits_1.ToolTip
data.value:
Find max/min value between wavelength limits.
Unchecked: Find max/min extremum within wavelength limits. If max/min value is at start wavelength, continue searching to shorter wavelengths. If max/imn value is at end wavelength, continue searching to longer wavelengths.
